name: git-helper
author: Marchand
description: Commit messages, PR descriptions and changelogs from your diff.

commands.name: commit-message
commands.description: Write a commit message for current changes
commands.prompt: Run `git diff --staged` (or `git diff` if nothing is staged) and `git log --oneline -10` to learn the repo's message style. Write ONE commit message in that style: short imperative subject (max 72 chars), blank line, a body explaining what and why. Do not run git commit.

commands.name: pr-description
commands.prompt: Run `git log --oneline main..HEAD` (or the right base branch) and `git diff main...HEAD --stat`, read the key changes, and write a PR description: Summary, Changes, How it was tested, Risks. {args}

commands.name: changelog
commands.description: Write changelog notes from recent commits
commands.prompt: Run `git log --oneline -30`, group the commits into Added / Changed / Fixed, and write user-facing changelog notes in plain English. {args}

tools.name: git_diff
tools.description: Show uncommitted changes (optionally for one path).
